words.sense: written or spoken to teach a moral lesson, sometimes preachily
misconceptions: Mistaking every correction for moral teaching.
Mistaking any teaching for needless nitpicking.

words.sense: excessively focused on minor details, technicalities, or strict rules
misconceptions: Mistaking every correction for moral teaching.
Mistaking any teaching for needless nitpicking.

semantic_axes.description: Moral teaching versus excessive attention to technical niceties.

edges.boundary_rule: Didactic language pushes a lesson about how to behave; pedantic language fusses over small formal details or rules.
